messages.subject: Edit genotypes
parts:
Hi,

I've been looking for potential genotype errors and hope to remove them from my data with the following code:

new_map<-est.map(all_data, error.prob=0.0075)
all_data<-replace.map(all_data,new_map)

all_data <- calc.errorlod(all_data, error.prob=0.0075)
toperr <- top.errorlod(all_data, cutoff=5)

map.clean <- all_data
for(i in 1:nrow(toperr)) {
  chr <- toperr$chr[i]
  id <- toperr$id[i]
  mar <- toperr$marker[i]
map.clean$geno[[chr]]$data[map.clean$pheno$id==id, mar] <- NA 
}

However, this doesn't seem to edit the genotypes (i.e. insert NA at individual genotypes which are flagged as potential errors? 

Can anyone suggest where I'm going wrong. It's driving me mad.

Thanks,

Richard
